description: This Java class 'ExecutePeriodicAccrualCommandHandler' implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and processes commands related to executing periodic accrual accounting within the Fineract project. It is annotated as a Spring service with a specific command type.

classes.name: ExecutePeriodicAccrualCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles the execution of periodic accrual commands in the Fineract accounting module.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JsonCommand to execute loans periodic accrual via the writePlatformService.
